routing_boundaries.interview: interview-me extracts intent one question at a time; grill-me stress-tests an already formed plan or design.
routing_boundaries.planning: planning-and-task-breakdown decomposes approved requirements; spec-driven-development creates a specification when requirements or architecture are unclear.
routing_boundaries.quality: code-review-and-quality reviews completed changes; doubt-driven-development performs adversarial checks during high-risk implementation.
routing_boundaries.security: security-and-hardening designs defenses in code; scope-creep audits project ownership and misplaced artifacts.
routing_boundaries.debugging: debugging-and-error-recovery owns observed failures; karpathy-guidelines constrains implementation style and prevents speculative complexity.
routing_boundaries.workflow: git-workflow-and-versioning owns branch/commit/version mechanics; incremental-implementation owns multi-file delivery slices; handoff owns agent transfer context.
routing_boundaries.humanizer: Route only for human-facing UI strings/copy only. Do not route for code, data, YAML/frontmatter, link targets, localization keys, accessibility semantics, technical/reference prose, agent-facing docs, or product logic unless explicitly requested. Preserve claims, user voice, placeholders, interpolation tokens, markup, accessibility text, and localization keys.
